mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The underlying prefill/decode service model inherits all v40 limitations and is not a live serving-engine measurement.
The controller uses exact queue age and predicted kernel service from the fitted model. Production estimates will have noise and CPU overhead.
When no decode work is ready, the controller uses the remaining prompt monolithically. It does not reserve periodic decode slots for future arrivals.
Queue-age thresholds and service budgets are hand-designed controls, not optimized against a training trace or formal SLO objective.
All policies remain FCFS within the prefill queue and use one prefill action per decode action. Tenant fairness and request priorities are excluded.
model: The v40 measured-service prefill/decode model with online chunk selection from predicted prefill service time and oldest prefill queue age.

validation.accounting: The v40 simulator continues to assert exact prefill/decode tokens, exact causal pairs, finite completion, max batch 64, and KV within budget. The adaptive selector additionally asserts valid upward service-time choices and zero slice-budget violations.
